cases.trigger: Discover an ERP module and stop before design approval.
expected: Record discovery evidence via the canonical run

cases.trigger: Refactor an existing shared adapter without changing behavior.
expected: Compare focused tests before and after
must_not: Replace shared behavior without regression evidence

cases.trigger: A user asks for a Supabase schema or RLS change without migration/security approval.
must_not: Claim RLS is verified from SQL text alone

cases.trigger: Review a cross-tenant read path in a module.
expected: Identify tenant scoping and permission boundaries
must_not: Infer tenant isolation from UI filtering alone

cases.trigger: A desktop ERP action is added to a module requiring desktop web, mobile web, iOS and Android.
expected: Classify operation coverage on all required platforms
Block missing actions or record approved adaptation
must_not: Call visible data an implemented action
Assume native behavior from a web route
